document.title: AI-Enhanced Public Procurement Platform
document.description: With my teammate Amaizu Melody, we built an MVP of an AI and blockchain-powered platform for transparent and efficient public procurement processes. We were chosen as one of the two winner teams by the jury.

image.caption: Certification of completion of the best solution at the AI for Connectivity hackathon, 27. - 29.1.2025

relatedLinks.description: The hackathon where we developed our solution

body.raw:
Built an AI and blockchain-powered platform for transparent and efficient public procurement processes during the AI for Connectivity Hackathon. The solution aimed to reduce corruption and improve resource allocation in public sector procurement.

## Key Features

- **AI-assisted RFP creation**: AI-assisted creation of RFPs
- **Automated Bid Evaluation**: AI-powered analysis and evaluation of procurement proposals
- **Transparent Audit Trails**: Blockchain-based immutable record keeping

## Key Learnings

1. **Technology Integration**: Combining AI and blockchain technologies can create more transparent procurement processes
2. **Balance**: Public sector innovation requires careful balance of efficiency and accountability
3. **Team Dynamics**: Cross-functional teams and skillsets enable comprehensive problem-solving in complex domains

## Impact & Next Steps

The platform demonstrated how emerging technologies can be leveraged to serve public good while maintaining accountability. We're currently exploring opportunities to:

- Refine the solution: focusing on core features and real-life procurement scenarios
- Open-source strategy: Leaning more towards open source & establishing our strategy
- Considering feedback from mentors and improving our solution

document.title: #herHACK 2024 - Switzerland's biggest female-led hackathon
document.description: Achieved 2nd place in herHACK 2024, developing a prototype for promoting green and sustainable coding practices at SBB
relatedManifestoPrinciples: Human-centered design over pure technological advancement

image.caption: Our team Green Tech Innovators presenting the solution at herHACK 2024

relatedLinks.title: LinkedIn post by the CIO of SBB
relatedLinks.description: The CIO of SBB wrote an encouraging LinkedIn post of the event, mentioning us

body.raw:
Participated in herHACK 2024, Switzerland's largest female-led hackathon, where our team secured 2nd place.

## The Challenge

We tackled the challenge of how might we raise awareness among the SBB developer community in green and sustainable coding practices. The goal was to create solutions that would:

- Raise awareness about green coding among developers and management
- Bring sustainability to the forefront of software devopment practices
- Introduce concrete measures or programs to guide sustainable development in everyday activities

## Our Solution

We developed a prototype of:

1. **Script for evaluating how sustainable the code is**: Runs through the code and gives actionable feedback
2. **New section on their existing dashboard showing green coding metrics**: Shows relevant metrics that can be looked at in weekly meetings
3. **Grass roots ownership**: Assigning ambassadors among developers to keep up to date and share green coding guidelines at SBB

## Key Learnings

1. **Rapid Prototyping**: The importance of quick iterations and feedback in hackathon settings
2. **Clear Communication**: The value of presenting technical solutions to non-technical audiences
3. **Team Collaboration**: Effective coordination in time-constrained environments

## Impact & Recognition

Our solution was recognized for its:
- Approach to integrate it in existing workflows
- Taking into consideration different roles (e.g. developers and managers)

## Next Steps

We're currently:
- Invited to SBB headquarters in Bern to discuss our solution further (planned for February 2025)

body.raw:
Contributing to Kiwix, an open-source project that makes Wikipedia and other educational content available offline, reaching millions of users without reliable internet access.

## The Impact

Kiwix enables access to knowledge for:
- Students in areas with limited connectivity
- Educational institutions in developing regions
- Communities during humanitarian crises
- Inhabitants in countries where the internet is censored
- Users with bandwidth constraints

## My Contributions

### General Improvements
- Email automation scenarios (newsletters + fundraising emails)
- Visual and content improvements in app stores and GitHub repositories & readme files
- User Survey creation

## Key Learnings

1. **Global Impact**: Open source contributions can reach millions of users worldwide
2. **Digital Inclusion**: Technical solutions can bridge significant digital divides
3. **Community Power**: Collaborative development drives meaningful change
4. **User-Centric Design**: Importance of considering diverse user needs and constraints

## Get Involved

Join us in making knowledge accessible to everyone:
- Contribute code on GitHub
- Help with translations
- Test new features
- Spread the word about Kiwix

document.description: Creating this personal website without writing a single line of code myself, to share learnings and document my journey.

body.raw:
Building a personal website leveraging various AI tools, as a 'digital garden' to share learnings, document my journey, and contribute to the tech community.

## The Vision

Created this space to:
- Share learnings and insights
- Document project experiences
- Build in public
- Showcase my skills and ambitions

## Technical Implementation

### Core Technologies
- Next.js for modern web development
- MDX for rich content management
- Tailwind CSS for beautiful styling
- GitHub Pages for deployment

### Key Features
- Responsive design
- Content categorization
- Interactive components

## Learning Journey

### Technical Growth
- Static site generation
- Accessibility considerations
- Amplifying my learn by doing approach

## Key Learnings

1. **Iteration**: Continuous improvement
2. **Community**: Value of sharing my experiences
3. **Technical Skills**: Practical application of web technologies & AI-assisted coding

## Future Plans

Continuing to grow this space with:
- More detailed write-ups
- More advanced features
- Better UX & content
